description: Extract pinakes/ml/ into its own PRIVATE repo `lugh` (the specialized local-only KFT fine-tuning provider), history-preserving, then sever it from pinakes. See docs/LUGH-EXTRACTION-PLAN.md. DELICATE: rewrites history + creates/pushes a new repo — intended to be run attended and reviewed before merge, NOT relied on for auto-merge. Independent of the paused flatten band (nothing imports ml/).

userStories.title: History-preserving split into a new private `lugh` repo
userStories.description: Split ml/ out with its commit history and create the private repo, seeded with its own chief program so `cd lugh && chief run` can bootstrap it.
acceptanceCriteria: A history-preserving split of ml/ (git subtree split or git filter-repo --path ml/ --path-rename ml/:) produces a branch/repo where the ml/ contents are the repo root and the commit history is retained (not a flat snapshot).
`gh repo create <owner>/lugh --private` created the repo and the split was pushed as main.

lugh is seeded with a .chief/ (config + a real verify.sh running `uv sync --extra dev` then pytest/ruff) and tasks/chief/ populated from this repo's tasks/extraction-staging/lugh/*.json (10-bootstrap … 40-port-general-train-harness).
In a fresh clone of lugh, `uv sync --extra dev` succeeds and `uv run python -m pytest --co` collects the suite.

userStories.title: Sever ml/ from pinakes + leave a pointer
userStories.description: Remove ml/ from pinakes and record where it went, updating the planning docs' 'ml/ stays' notes.
acceptanceCriteria: ml/ is removed from pinakes; `git grep -l pinakes_ml -- ':!docs' ':!tasks'` returns nothing (no code depended on it — it was one-directional).

README + docs note that the ML/training workspace now lives in the private `lugh` repo as `lugh:agent:finetune`; docs/ML-EXTRACTION-ANALYSIS.md and docs/UNIFIED-PROJECT-PLAN.md are updated from 'ml/ stays' to 'ml/ extracted to lugh'.
pinakes still builds and tests pass without ml/: `bun run check` and `uv run --project engine pytest` are green.
The tasks/extraction-staging/ directory is removed from pinakes (its contents now live in lugh).
